name: Manifold Maladies
summary: At the start of each battle round, you may swap your chosen Nurgle's Gift Plague for a different one.

name: Warped and Rusted Animus
summary: Foetid Bloat-drones, Helbrutes and Myphitic Blight-haulers gain Contagion Engine and Assault on their ranged weapons. This detachment cannot be combined with another Engines-tagged detachment.

name: Deadly Vectors
summary: In your opponent's Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit (-1 if it's Below Half-strength): on 6 or less, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Miasmic Bombardment
summary: At the start of each battle round, mark 1/2/3 enemy units at Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught, each more than 12" from every model of yours on the battlefield, as Afflicted until the round ends.

name: Hypervirulent Strains
summary: Friendly Death Guard Character units get +3" Contagion Range, to a maximum of 12".

name: Numberless Horde
summary: In your Command phase in battle rounds 2-3 at Incursion, 2-4 at Strike Force or 2-5 at Onslaught, add a new Poxwalkers unit of 10 models to your army in Strategic Reserves. Poxwalkers gain Battleline.

name: Reverberant Rancidity
summary: Plague Legions units within 7" of a Death Guard unit gain Nurgle's Gift; Death Guard within 7" of a Plague Legions unit get +3" Contagion Range. You may take up to 500/1000/1500 pts of Plague Legions, none of which can be Warlord.

name: Worldblight
summary: At the end of your Command phase, an objective marker a Death Guard unit controls is secured; until you lose control of it, enemy units within range of that objective are Afflicted.
